verdict.rationale: DPMA documents a classical paper-based application route that can be filed by mail or by fax alongside its e-filing options, and links paper forms for national trade mark applications, so a non-online rail exists. The evidence does not show the exact postal addresses or fax numbers, and paper forms are evidenced only for trade marks. Missing for 10: exact mailing addresses, fax numbers, paper forms for patents/designs/other procedures, independent corroboration that the fallback works when online systems are down.
